description: RDF-ready JMS/JMR for the GloParT mass, from the Wqq tag-and-probe fit

corrections.name: JMS_scale
corrections.description: Multiplicative jet mass scale for MC, m' = JMS_scale * m. Derived from the fitted tp2jms/tp2jmr on the fit's own true-W templates.

inputs.name: WP
inputs.description: Wqq tagger working point of the fit

corrections.name: JMR_factor
corrections.description: MC jet mass resolution factor f (hybrid: gen-matched m' = m_gen + f*(m - m_gen), otherwise stochastic with JMR_sigmaRel). Derived from the fitted tp2jms/tp2jmr on the fit's own true-W templates.

inputs.name: WP
inputs.description: Wqq tagger working point of the fit

corrections.name: JMR_sigmaRel
corrections.description: Relative MC mass resolution of true W jets (core width / core mean). Derived from the fitted tp2jms/tp2jmr on the fit's own true-W templates.

inputs.name: WP
inputs.description: Wqq tagger working point of the fit
